title: Meta-labeling size tilt on LIT (L2 logistic, rank map x0.5-x1.5)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: can quant / ML meta-labeling (learn when a signal is likely to win, size it up or down) improve the strategies?
verdict: OOS AUC 0.557 (2026 H2 frozen 0.499); best model of the family lr_core AUC 0.595 permutation p 0.0099 (H2 0.7525). 2021-25 n=510 net +5,081 vs flat +1,211, 2-wk 5.0/7.6 vs 6.3/8.5, beats random sizing in 82.0%; 2026 H2 n=40 net +8,494 vs flat +9,493, 2-wk 23.1/0.0 vs 23.1/0.0, beats random sizing in 44.5%. Strict pass: False.
notes: tools/meta_label.py; research/quant/meta/lit.json; sized at the strategy's own size rule x the multiplier (P&L linear in micros); trades = walk-forward OOS span trades (untested months at x1).

params.map: m = 0.5 + percentile of p among the training predictions

method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
